findings.highlight: It sounds more like a plea than a warning
findings.evidenceJa: 懇願するような真摯さだった
findings.governingReading: The warning possesses an earnest sincerity like a plea.
findings.explanation: The English retains the plea comparison but removes Rin’s earnest sincerity and weakens an asserted quality into how it sounds.

findings.governingReading: Shirou grips his bandaged left arm tight.
findings.explanation: The English removes the force in Shirou’s physical grip as he confronts the danger.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの魔術を倣う
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks about learning or following Archer’s magecraft.
findings.explanation: The English turns learning a technical craft into imitation and collapses magecraft into generic magic.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつの魔術構成は引き出せない
findings.governingReading: Without loosening the cloth, Shirou cannot draw out Archer’s magecraft structure or construction.
findings.explanation: The English erases the structured technical object to be drawn out and calls it simply Archer’s magic.

findings.highlight: So I’m going to have you loosen the Shroud a bit.
findings.governingReading: Rin proposes the measure while explicitly acknowledging that it is unreasonable or excessive.
findings.explanation: The English omits Rin’s acknowledgment of the unreasonable risk before she proposes loosening the restraint.

findings.highlight: get used to what happens when you loosen it
findings.evidenceJa: 布が緩まった程度の反動には耐えられるようになっておかないと
findings.governingReading: Shirou must become able to withstand the degree of backlash produced by loosening the cloth.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a concrete tolerance threshold for backlash with vague familiarity with whatever happens.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの魔術構成を倣う
findings.governingReading: Shirou must learn or internalize Archer’s magecraft structure.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the specific magecraft construction into unspecified techniques.

findings.highlight: bear the flowback from the arm
findings.evidenceJa: できるだけ左腕からの逆流に耐えればいい
findings.governingReading: Shirou confirms that he must withstand the backflow from his left arm as much as he possibly can.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the maximum-effort qualification and the specification of the left arm.

findings.highlight: Your body just needs to experience
findings.evidenceJa: 身に染みさせるだけでいい
findings.governingReading: Shirou only needs to let Archer’s Projection technique soak into him or become embodied.
findings.explanation: The English reduces deliberate embodied absorption to the body merely experiencing the technique.

findings.highlight: Don’t worry about trying to understand it
findings.evidenceJa: 間違っても理解しようだなんて思わないでね
findings.governingReading: Rin warns Shirou under no circumstances even to think of trying to understand the technique intellectually.
findings.explanation: The English turns an emphatic safety prohibition into reassurance that he need not worry about understanding it.

findings.highlight: lays her cold hand on my back
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい手を背中に押し付けてきた
findings.governingReading: Illya presses her cold hands firmly against Shirou’s back.
findings.explanation: The English changes plural hands to one hand and weakens firm pressure into merely laying it there.

findings.highlight: Just close your eyes and meditate
findings.evidenceJa: シロウが一番得意な瞑想をして
findings.governingReading: Illya tells Shirou to perform the meditation he is best at.
findings.explanation: The English omits that this is Shirou’s strongest and most practiced form of meditation.

findings.highlight: Be sure to make desperate efforts, or the reaction will definitely swallow you
findings.evidenceJa: くれぐれも死ぬ気で耐えて。左腕からの反動で、シロウは間違いなく呑み込まれるから
findings.governingReading: Illya demands that Shirou endure with everything he has because the left arm’s backlash will certainly engulf him.
findings.explanation: The English changes the certain danger that motivates maximum effort into an outcome implied to occur only if he fails to try hard enough.

findings.governingReading: Shirou gathers or concentrates his consciousness.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes sensory faculties for consciousness in the technical account of opening his circuits.

findings.highlight: This step has gotten much easier over the past few days
findings.evidenceJa: たった数日の間に容易くなった擬似神経の作成
findings.governingReading: Constructing the pseudo-nerves has become easy in only a few days.
findings.explanation: The English hides both the pseudo-nerve construction and the strikingly short timescale behind the generic phrase “this step.”

findings.highlight: in a voice too vague to hear clearly
findings.governingReading: Illya speaks in a voice Shirou cannot hear clearly.
findings.explanation: The English describes the voice itself as “vague,” producing unnatural wording in place of low or indistinct audibility.
